lead: A floor check that passed for sessions can go red because the Docker daemon restarted without the test servers, and the line the ledger prints names something else.
body: `examples/queue.nvs` opens its stderr with a `warning[W1008]` about an ungranted `cache.shared` store, while the failure is two lines below it: `[db.main]` at `127.0.0.1:15432` refusing the connection. Run `docker ps` before reading a green-yesterday check as a regression, and `docker compose -f tests/db/compose.yaml up -d --wait postgres redis` brings the two servers back.
